subject: Request: Lumina Health pilot - combined discount + credits ask
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna@luminahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot extension + promotional ask

Hi Sergio —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Lumina's product and Redwood's inference performance look like a great fit for our clinical summarization pilot. Quick ask from our side as we finalize budget: we need an additional 60 days on the pilot and a pool of free credits to cover the expected spike during integration (roughly $50k of credits). Separately, the procurement team has asked whether we can get a 20% promotional discount on the first-year subscription if we commit within 30 days after the pilot.

I know these are above the standard trial, but this is a high-priority pilot for Lumina; if we can get both pieces in place we can accelerate the procurement timeline and commit to a 12-month purchase thereafter. Please let me know if this is something Redwood can consider and what the approval process looks like.

Appreciate it —
Anna Keller
VP, Product
Lumina Health

--
Attachment: Lumina_Requirements_Summary.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna@luminahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-07T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot extension + promotional ask

Anna — thanks for the clear ask and the context. We're excited to move Lumina forward. I'm looping in Marissa, Aditya and David to evaluate the commercial side and any approvals required.

Quick summary for internal reviewers: Lumina requests 60-day pilot extension + $50k in free hosted credits to cover integration spikes + 20% promotional discount on year-one subscription contingent on signing within 30 days of pilot close. They indicate a 12-month commit post-pilot. This exceeds my discount authority and could be a material credit.

Marissa / Aditya / David — can you advise on approval path and suggested counter / guardrails? I attached the SOW draft and the pricing sheet from my call notes.

Next steps I propose: 1) Internal approval or counter by EOD Friday 11/10; 2) If approved, finalize DocuSign with a usage cap and commit term; 3) Coordinate procurement questions.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-08T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Pilot extension + promotional ask

Sergio / Aditya — reviewed Lumina's ask and attached pricing. Commercial rationale: Lumina is in the health vertical (strategic for our compliance play) and the use case volume will create meaningful MRR if they convert. I recommend a middle ground to protect unit economics while keeping the deal live. Suggested concession package:

- Pilot extension: +45 days (instead of 60)
- Free credits: $30,000 applied to hosted API usage only
- Promotional discount: 15% off year-one list for a signed 12-month commit within 45 days of pilot close

Conditions to include in DocuSign: credits expire 90 days after pilot end; credits are only for inference calls (no embeddings re-runs), and any overage billed at standard rates. Finance (David) — please confirm cost impact and whether $30k is within tolerance.

If Aditya is comfortable, we can present this to Lumina as a firm counter.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Manager, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com

--
Attachment: Commercial_Rationale_Lumina.docx (doc stub)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T11:46:00-08:00
Subject: APPROVAL: Lumina counter (with conditions)

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround. I approve Marissa's counter with these firm conditions:

1) Free credits limited to $30,000 and restricted to hosted inference token usage only; credits expire 90 days after pilot conclusion.
2) Promotional discount set at 15% for year-one and only applies if Lumina signs a 12-month committed plan within 45 days after pilot end.
3) Include an automatic rollback clause: if usage during pilot exceeds the agreed test patterns by >3x, we reserve the right to pause credits and re-evaluate terms.

David — please confirm billing and revenue recognition notes and add the special terms to the order form. Legal should confirm the rollback language. Once paperwork and DocuSign link exist, Sergio please close the loop with Lumina and get procurement contact signature.

Aditya Rao
VP Sales, Americas
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com

Anna / Lumina procurement — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. We can agree to the following concession package:

- Pilot extension: +45 days beyond the original end date
- Free hosted API credits: $30,000 (applies to inference token use only; expires 90 days after pilot end)
- Promotional discount: 15% off year-one list pricing if Lumina signs a 12-month committed plan within 45 days after pilot close

Important operational notes: credits will be consumed against hosted API consumption; any unanticipated large-batch re-runs (more than 3x the test traffic profile) may trigger a pause on credits until we mutually review usage. These guardrails are to protect both teams and keep the pilot aligned with expected evaluation patterns.

I've sent the DocuSign packet for the SOW + special terms here: https://docusign.example.com/ntf/abcd-1234
Please have procurement sign the order form to lock the promotional discount. Once signed, we'll provision the extended pilot and load the credits into your account.

Next steps for Lumina: 1) Review and sign DocuSign; 2) Confirm any technical ramp schedule with our Solutions Engineer (cc'd separately after signature); 3) Provide PO if required by procurement.

Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through the terms.

Best —
